plan.summary: This 4-week block starts the 12-week off-camp cycle for boxing with a simple full-body build emphasis that fits one 60-minute S&C session per week and leaves room for skill work. Week 1 establishes baseline performance with a squat assessment so later loading can be adjusted cleanly, and the main training work begins in Week 2. The block keeps priorities in the right order for off-camp striking: basic power first, then main strength, then practical accessories, with a short conditioning finish.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build general strength and simple power with low-complexity exercises while keeping a small conditioning dose.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the main lifts and throws gradually while trimming any work that does not add clear return.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep strength in place and express it faster with sharper power and speed-focused work.

exercises.name: Box Jump
exercises.notes: Use a low box and stick each landing softly. Step down each rep and keep every jump crisp.

substitutionOptions.name: Countermovement Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if no stable box is available. Reset between reps and jump as high as you can with a controlled landing.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Warm up progressively, then work up to your heaviest clean set of 3-5 reps. This sets your baseline for the next block, so stop when form slows or breaks.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your heaviest clean set of 3-5 reps. Log the load and reps so the app can estimate your current baseline.

performanceTarget.prompt: Track your best clean top set and keep technique solid.

substitutionOptions.name: Double Dumbbell Front Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if the goblet load is too light. Keep the torso tall and hit the same clean 3-5 rep top set.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.notes: Leave 1-2 good reps in reserve. Keep the ribs down, body straight, and full control at the bottom.

substitutionOptions.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if push-ups are too easy or wrist position is better on dumbbells. Lower under control and press hard.

substitutionOptions.name: Incline Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if full push-ups are not yet clean. Pick a height that lets you move well for all reps.

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.notes: Drive the elbow back without twisting the torso. Pause briefly at the top and control the lower.

substitutionOptions.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if lower-back support is needed. Keep the chest planted and row through full range.

exercises.name: Suitcase Carry
exercises.notes: Walk tall without leaning toward the weight. Keep the ribs stacked and grip the handle hard.

substitutionOptions.name: Farmer Carry
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if matching loads are easier to set up. Walk tall and controlled.

exercises.name: Shadow Boxing Conditioning
exercises.notes: Stay relaxed and sharp. Keep footwork light and punch volume smooth rather than frantic.

endurancePrescription.rest: 1 min easy walk or nose breathing

exercises.name: Box Jump

substitutionOptions.name: Countermovement Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if no stable box is available. Reset between reps and land quietly.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Use the Week 1 result to choose a load that lets you move well with strong posture. Keep all reps smooth and controlled.

performanceTarget.prompt: Track the heaviest clean set of 6 that still looks solid.

substitutionOptions.name: Double Dumbbell Front Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if the goblet load is too light. Keep the torso tall and depth consistent.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
exercises.notes: Press hard from a stable shoulder position. Pause lightly on the floor and avoid bouncing.

substitutionOptions.name: Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if dumbbells are limited. Elevate the feet slightly only if you can keep clean form.

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row

substitutionOptions.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if you want less trunk demand. Pull to the lower ribs.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Push the hips back and keep the dumbbells close to the legs. Stop when hamstring tension is high and spine position stays solid.

substitutionOptions.name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if loading is limited. Keep the free hip square and move slowly.

exercises.name: Suitcase Carry
exercises.notes: Stay tall and level through the trunk. Use a load that challenges you without dragging your posture down.

substitutionOptions.name: Farmer Carry
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if carrying one side is awkward in your space. Walk with short, controlled steps.

exercises.name: Jump Rope Conditioning
exercises.notes: Stay springy and relaxed. Keep the pace honest but do not turn it into a max-effort test.

exercises.name: Box Jump
exercises.notes: Keep the box height conservative and focus on a fast takeoff. Land softly and step down.

substitutionOptions.name: Countermovement Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if no stable box is available. Jump high, reset, and repeat.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Add a small amount of load from Week 2 if all sets were clean. Keep the torso tall and drive up with intent.

performanceTarget.prompt: Track the best set of 5 with full depth and clean speed.

substitutionOptions.name: Double Dumbbell Front Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if the goblet setup is no longer challenging enough. Keep elbows up and depth consistent.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
exercises.notes: Use a slightly heavier load than last week if bar path and shoulder position stay clean. Press fast but stay controlled.

substitutionOptions.name: Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if dumbbells are limited. Slow the lower and drive up hard.

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.notes: Pull hard through the elbow and keep the torso quiet. Finish each rep fully.

substitutionOptions.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if bracing on the free hand is uncomfortable. Squeeze at the top.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Use a smooth hinge and keep tension in the hamstrings. Do not chase extra range by rounding.

substitutionOptions.name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if loading is limited. Move with balance and control.

exercises.name: Weighted Sit-Up
exercises.notes: Hold the load close to the chest and move under control. Do not yank the neck forward.

substitutionOptions.name: Dumbbell Dead Bug
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if sit-ups bother the hips or back. Keep the low back flat throughout.

exercises.name: Shadow Boxing Conditioning
exercises.notes: Work at a steady pace with clean technique and active feet. Breathe through the nose during the first half of each round if possible.

exercises.name: Box Jump
exercises.notes: Keep every jump fast and easy. Stop well before fatigue affects takeoff or landing.

substitutionOptions.name: Countermovement Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if no stable box is available. Keep the same crisp, low-fatigue intent.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Use the same load as Week 3 or slightly lighter and make every rep look sharp. This week is for recovery while keeping the pattern solid.

performanceTarget.prompt: Track your cleanest work set and leave the session feeling fresh.

substitutionOptions.name: Double Dumbbell Front Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if the goblet setup is too light. Keep effort controlled this week.

substitutionOptions.name: Push-Up
